- China markets surge on tech and index reshuffles: [Hong Kong stocks rally](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxQX0wtWWRxYUZDT1kzTTBXUWFaY1UxUjZ0UE0wRTVEUVhVcmZ3NDYwZTZMa2l6OVF4T2JYNm53X1BBV3RlSWNQemhDVUNYWU5TeF9Wbm9hYXZkcGRXM21lS3pqWXJHeENqQTVqYUhtdW83RFE2b0FnQWQ2VGc4dlhtRjM0eE9xRHl4S3NkTE9scnVaeHdGMEZxMldB) with Hang Seng Tech up 3%, and [A-share turnover tops 2.5 trillion yuan](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE9HNnZiRk5taDlRU0N2Q2tIOElKdG00RVU2NHRnZEIwSzFzLUM0RUJvVUItRmhzakVMVm1FWHdhb0lQU0JmTFVfbkV3SnNLSG9VVFZJ) as [index reshuffle](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3355523/china-index-reshuffle-entrench-tech-trades-and-boost-ai-rally-brokerages) boosts tech weighting.
- Tariff and stablecoin risks reshape trade dynamics: [Trump proposes 25% tariff on Brazilian goods](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/02/trump-proposes-25-tariff-on-brazil.html) under Section 301, while [ECB warns stablecoins could trigger bank runs](https://news.google.) and backs digital euro to offset dollar stablecoin risks.
- Consumer and corporate shifts: [Amazon Prime Day runs June 23-26](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/02/amazon-prime-day-shopping-inflation.html) as sentiment hits record low; [Stephen Curry partners with Li-Ning](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/02/stephen-curry-nba-deal-li-ning-china.html); and [Food Republic exits China](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3355586/food-republic-joins-wave-foreign-brands-retreating-china) as foreign brands retreat.
- Major fund flows: [Blackstone closes $13.1B Asia fund](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/02/blackstone-largest-asia-private-equity-fund.html), [Barry Diller bids $18B for MGM](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/01/barry-diller-people-mgm-resorts), and [Unitree clears IPO hurdle](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3355538/unitree-clears-key-hurdle-shanghai-ipo-chinas-humanoid-robot-wave-gathers-pace) for humanoid robot listing in Shanghai.

society.en:
- **Russia launches massive overnight attack on Ukraine**, killing at least 11 in Kyiv and trapping people under rubble, as rescuers race to clear damaged residential buildings across eight districts. ([Massive Russian attack](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5y8nq8ljqwo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Iran war ceasefire talks stall** as White House pushes for a deal under polling pressure, while Iran demands concessions. Meanwhile, US military strikes on alleged drug boats have killed over 200 since September, raising legal and ethical questions. ([Bowen on Iran](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cedp3lee059o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [US strikes](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/02/g-s1-125314/us-military-strikes-on-alleged-drug-boats))
- **Google parent Alphabet announces $80bn stock sale** to fund AI plans, including $10bn from Berkshire Hathaway, signaling massive corporate investment in AI despite market volatility. ([Alphabet AI](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/6/2/google-parent-alphabet-to-sell-80bn-in-stock-to-fund-ai-plans?traffic_source=rss))
- **US Defense Department bars journalists from its press office**, drawing condemnation as another attack on independent military reporting, while a missing lab worker in New Mexico is found dead, adding to a string of scientist deaths that sparked conspiracy theories. ([DOD journalists](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/6/2/us-defense-department-bars-journalists-from-its-press-office?traffic_source=rss), [Lab worker](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0723mr8j3po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **China warns of AI-powered exam fraud** as教育部 alerts students to fake “AI高考押题” scams, while Zhihu reports 23.6% revenue decline and pivots to AI commercialization, highlighting the double-edged nature of AI hype. ([AI fraud warning](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE5YZVdvblhjeE5QZU9YOXRrNmp3RnhyVWhESEczOHVDUEFRUVVqVlFmWm1zQlFDSy02T2VGMkNONGI0VnJBNkgwSGpiYjBmQW9EamFHb3ZxUlg0LTVJaFdEMlUwWTQ4LWNqZmc), [Zhihu revenue](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ))

military.zh:
- 俄乌战争第1560天，俄军启用炫彩涂料对抗AI无人机，显示人工智能在战场识别与反制领域的竞赛正深刻改变战术规则，[Russian Trucks Get ‘Dazzle’ Paint To Throw Off AI-Enabled Drones](https://www.twz.com/news-features/russian-trucks-get-dazzle-paint-to-throw-off-ai-enabled-drones)。
- 美伊停火濒临破裂，伊朗暂停谈判并威胁封锁霍尔木兹海峡，全球原油运输命脉面临中断风险，能源市场剧烈震荡，[U.S.-Iran Ceasefire On The Brink After Tit-For-Tat Attacks](https://www.twz.com/news-features/u-s-iran-ceasefire-on-the-brink-after-tit-for-tat-attacks)。
- 美防长赫格塞斯在香会“敲警钟”要求盟友增加军费应对中国扩张，同时AUKUS潜艇采购方案改为直接出售三艘现役弗吉尼亚级，印太水下军备竞赛加速，[Pentagon chief sounds ‘alarm’ over China’s buildup](https://www.defensenews.com/news/pentagon-congress/2026/06/01/pentagon-chief-sounds-alarm-over-chinas-buildup-urges-allies-to-boost-defense-spending/)、[U.S. Will Sell 3 In-service Virginia Subs to Australia](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/01/u-s-will-sell-3-in-service-virginia-subs-to-australia-instead-of-1-new-2-in-service)。
- 菲律宾正核实中国可能在黄岩岛新建结构，中国海警在南海持续行动，中日菲海上摩擦风险升高，[Philippines Verifying Reports of Structure in Scarborough Shoal](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/philippines-verifying-reports-of-structure-in-scarborough-shoal/)、[针对日菲举动，中国海警行动，解读来了！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE9ZNGFyVWp5SWwtWVpnRzRyVG9uWVh0U2E1cmlwMGhZbnRHclJsNXpKaEV6WmwyUlFVZW1IZGprV0Z1U2pGcDJXOWRRcXhsYk5XR2NHdkxvaks5bFRlWHRxdXhlbkZoeHRwUGFScHBwSW85SDQ)。
- 美国众议院推动陆军研究海面无人艇用于护航，海军与陆军无人化作战体系加速融合，[House Wants the Army to Consider Sea Drones for Watercraft Escort Missions](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/01/house-wants-the-army-to-consider-sea-drones-for-watercraft-escort-missions)。
military.en:
* **US-Iran crisis deepens:** Iran suspends talks and threatens continued Hormuz closure, while the ceasefire appears on the brink after tit-for-tat attacks. Kuwait activates air defenses as missiles and drones target the Gulf state. [US-Iran Ceasefire On The Brink](https://www.twz.com/news-features/u-s-iran-ceasefire-on-the-brink-after-tit-for-tat-attacks) | [Iran suspends US talks](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxNb2JnVDF4RVJNWTF6cVRLZnZDdVlWVkgtMGxfbWMyYVVwNXVSVGZBbWdmMHJTSENkY0laakhxMGlhVDhLd1JTNkpIME1tMDltcE1VaU1udnkwQzVnaEVLZDdKay1WRDJ1ODc5dFNwTm1jRmVtZ3A4bWM1dlV1dklKc05BWF90RlRWUVRTdGM2dVR1WjVTelFHU2dUWQ) | [Kuwait Activates Air Defenses](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxNSkxoZTVkS0NUbkluX3NsczJYSUdtVDU3T29KOWVJYS0wcmRSU1BoU2hsZWF3NkF1Q2xReE1EMG9Qd3lSLXVxVHlCMjlYZTZUcktOc3REWGU5eU1hTE1yWl9URjd0WTVfVzFxV2hxazJJVC1TcjRETmtzdXU4VEJTM3VCT2RxWk9oSi1WSjExOC0wTzV1RkxXM3FHX1F3alBhRlhKWC1WcmdfS1VMYWZjaml2QmhaMkNOTUFjdl9xcjBkQ09zb0V1UEd3)
* **Russia intensifies war in Ukraine:** A massive strike with ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and drones hits Kyiv. Moscow also employs 'dazzle' paint on trucks to confuse AI-enabled drone targeting. Meanwhile, Asia continues buying from Russia's 'dark fleet' despite risks, and a Romanian strike exposes NATO's eastern flank vulnerabilities. [Russian massive strike](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxOU0RWbXRzcGp1dWZFcUJwUFM3aWpQd2psa1JpeXBRVk10UkNDVlMyVWVXdTM1ZWlmSXBuX1pjUVZZSTdUajJScGFsTTlsdkxEZ0swOTllVGVvMUlaQTVqbFBDVmtPZWhydVU2WXBBemk3d19BUGcySjdmV1hpcXdaUTBZd2dLWERYUEhISmFsTlpXdmVvY3pnend4dkwzSnVFRF9FV2lvTHlQaUc1UHl1MFllMmZiWmw4emkyOTIwTzVGa0gwZkZTcw) | [Russian Dazzle Paint](https://www.twz.com/news-features/russian-trucks-get-dazzle-paint-to-throw-off-ai-enabled-drones) | [Oil-hungry Asia](https://news.google.) | [Romania Strike](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTFB3S0JfVmw0enFYdUxYRFBLcVBMYmtKalRCOG9sVGtOY29hbUlQVVRRY1ZHc3lkaUZ3eFRQSjNZWDByN09rTGg0dTczZ0lDWUE)
* **China military buildup accelerates:** Pentagon chief sounds alarm and urges allies to boost defense spending. The Philippines verifies reports of a new Chinese structure in Scarborough Shoal, while Japan and Philippines deepen military cooperation. AUKUS revises its plan: the US will sell three in-service Virginia-class submarines to Australia. [Pentagon chief](https://www.defensenews.com/news/pentagon-congress/2026/06/01/pentagon-chief-sounds-alarm-over-chinas-buildup-urges-allies-to-boost-defense-spending/) | [Scarborough Shoal](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/philippines-verifying-reports-of-structure-in-scarborough-shoal/) | [Japan-Philippines](https://news.google.) | [Virginia subs](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/01/u-s-will-sell-3-in-service-virginia-subs-to-australia-instead-of-1-new-2-in-service)
* **Drone warfare and maritime operations evolve:** Ukraine emerges as a drone superpower, offering strategic partnerships to the Middle East. The US House pushes the Army to consider sea drones for escort missions. US strikes on suspected drug boats in the Eastern Pacific kill at least 200. [Ukraine drone superpower](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE9QSHlTTThOem1tbkp6bUw3YzBtdm5MRGszYUN6d1Fiakt5REFWTVZFdkVFX0NlUS1MSkd2US1sU0V1WldVQlZEQVVtQnRMWVhETmVXQkRhSVFOa2FmOUk2NHA5bVBQRnUtTFdLdTdB) | [House sea drones](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/01/house-wants-the-army-to-consider-sea-drones-for-watercraft-escort-missions) | [Drug boat strikes](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/01/at-least-200-people-killed-in-u-s-strikes-on-suspected-drug-boats)
* **Hybrid conflict frontlines expand:** Taiwan and Poland are highlighted as key fronts in hybrid warfare. China’s military-linked labs seek Nvidia AI chips, and Beijing warns of supply chain disruption to the US. [Taiwan Poland](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxNYlFOVW1XNlNnTm5WaVdkQWFWX1NDQXBqVl96ZWl6dlc2QU1Yb1MxRjh0SE5sZW9VN19BXzItQUJtUFU4c2pkcHBVUmRacmVjYmNtQ19OSzhVSkg0WHpuT1ZIWXdNXzA3d2FYcjBGR0czSUFFT3ZWWUE3eFNrNWNNczh3bElNREhkVWNyUTljOA) | [China lab Nvidia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE92Q0dQMDVmc3NKQzZqUlNMdGFDWnFRelJkOWVaREJqQzBrSnFubldfY2QyWk9rbHNZVHMycVZEMFFuRWJ2cEo2UTdHNFo5eFhOSks1YjU3dF9NRTlQR2NJLTFTeWh2bllyR3c) | [China disruption](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE12WDhOWlNZeDRVOVFfQ2MyRkFPeHh3SnFXMGx2eF9GQzVyWXhUTF9nVjNkR0NVaDlIRDAxVFNDaUw4ckM1cmJyMkE5RVN0b3lMa0JWelBqdnZ0UnRleGtxQ2VMdWNuMjBpUlE)

tech.zh:
- [Nvidia chases $200B CPU market with AI agent PCs](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/nvidia-chases-200b-cpu-market-with-ai-agent-pcs-from-microsoft-dell-and-hp/) 联手微软戴尔惠普，意图颠覆PC市场，同时[OpenAI被诉协助大规模枪击](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czx2j0v8d2xo)，AI安全伦理再受拷问。
- 传统车企电动化遇挫：[Lexus取消LF-ZC电动轿车](https://electrek.co/2026/06/01/toyota-pulls-plug-most-important-evs/)和[丰田放弃固态电池Lexus EV](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPUWhUQ3lpWUdqYzhGTE5INU5ISzdEM24zd3RpRlpuSnJyUlVxMDM2Skxnb1JWeXpfcFlqRGdJdWZmWjJzb2FQRTRGTVIwMTV4WE5Dbkx3NlRDMG1SaWxKejdWOEVfQXlQdWVPX090ckZaNnZUcXBUdlEtRklKSTJQQjVURXdsZw)，而[BYD计划2027年量产全固态电池](https://electrek.co/2026/06/01/byd-all-solid-state-batteries-evs-by-2027/)，中韩厂商加速领跑。
- [AMD Radeon RX 9070 GRE](https://www.engadget.com/2185302/amd-radeon-rx-9070-gre-review/)以549美元定价冲击中端显卡市场，为高价时代提供高性价比选择。
- Hacker News热议[macOS UI网格缺失](https://blog.hopefullyuseful.com/blog/macos-needs-its-grid-back/)与[社交年龄验证对自由互联网的威胁](https://mullvad.net/en/blog/age-verification-for-social-media-the-beginning-of-the-end-for-a-free-internet)，开发者社区聚焦系统设计与社会影响。
tech.en:
* Nvidia's push into AI agent PCs with partners like Microsoft, Dell, and HP [Nvidia chases $200B CPU market](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/nvidia-chases-200b-cpu-market-with-ai-agent-pcs-from-microsoft-dell-and-hp/) signals a convergence of AI software and consumer hardware, challenging traditional CPU dominance and reshaping the PC market. This crosses the AI and 科技产品 beats.
* Toyota's cancellation of the Lexus LF-ZC EV [Toyota pulls the plug](https://electrek.co/2026/06/01/toyota-pulls-plug-most-important-evs/) and BYD's plan to deploy all-solid-state batteries by 2027 [BYD plans all-solid-state](https://electrek.co/2026/06/01/byd-all-solid-state-batteries-evs-by-2027/) highlight a dramatic split in automotive strategy—one retreating from next-gen EVs, the other accelerating—with major implications for supply chains and consumer adoption (汽车 + AI/Battery tech).
* The OpenAI lawsuit in Florida [OpenAI let ChatGPT aid](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czx2j0v8d2xo) and Groq's surprising funding [How is Groq raising more money?](https://www.zach.be/p/how-the-hell-is-groq-raising-more) underscore the volatile legal and financial landscape for AI companies, where trust and capital are under simultaneous pressure (AI + HackNews社区动态).
* The TUI renaissance highlighted by Jane Street [strace-ui, Bonsai_term](https://blog.janestreet.com/strace-ui-bonsai-term-and-the-tui-renaissance/) and the macOS grid debate [macOS needs its grid back](https://blog.hopefullyuseful.com/blog/macos-needs-its-grid-back/) reflect a community-driven backlash against complex UIs and a desire for simpler, more efficient interfaces that could influence future 科技产品 design (HackNews社区动态 + 科技产品).

sports.zh:
- 世界杯临近，足球与篮球频现重磅：伊朗核心阿兹蒙意外落选引发争议，法国后卫萨利巴伤疑；库里签约李宁开启中国品牌新篇章，NBA总决赛前瞻聚焦文班亚马vs布伦森。
- 名帅阿德尔曼逝世，篮球界与虎扑社区共同悼念；足球方面，巴西名帅奎罗斯力挺托马斯·帕尔特伊入选加纳队。
- 加拿大男篮集结：SGA领衔承诺未来三季参赛，贾马尔·穆雷与维金斯缺阵；足球方面，戴维斯已与国家队会合但状态未明。
- 羽毛球印尼公开赛开打，国羽全主力出击；王祉怡出战日本公开赛四强；虎扑社区热议00后演员李思潼票房破10亿。
sports.en:

美股.en:
- [Alphabet plans to raise $80 billion](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/01/alphabet-to-raise-80-billion-from-stock-sales-to-fund-ai-buildout.html) through stock sales, with Berkshire Hathaway investing $10 billion, signaling massive AI infrastructure spending that will test investor appetite for dilution.
- [HPE skyrockets 30%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/01/hpe-stock-earnings-q2.html) on a blowout earnings beat driven by Cloud & AI server revenue, reinforcing that AI demand is converting into real profits for enterprise hardware plays.
- [Trump proposes 25% tariff on Brazilian goods](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/02/trump-proposes-25-tariff-on-brazil.html) under Section 301, escalating trade tensions and threatening supply chains in agriculture and manufacturing, with potential ripple effects on inflation.
- [Amazon Prime Day](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/02/amazon-prime-day-shopping-inflation.html) set for June 23-26 comes as consumer sentiment hits a record low, testing whether discount events can revive spending amid inflation and war uncertainty.
- The stock market's narrow AI-led rally mirrors [dot-com bubble patterns](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/01/the-stock-market-just-did-something-eerily-similar-to-the-dotcom-bubble-top-in-2000.html), with May gains concentrated in AI-adjacent names, raising concentration risk for passive investors.

- [European stocks fell](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxONkxTRmJ3NUFwR3dvSFl5RldyZjNBLURZS3JoMkpxcWNyeUFCanNrdzJ6eERWWHhCVXgwYXI3SjNjeW5rVFFXWVdYUTJ1TVhQdldoRFVTb2tzNDRDLVVqbDAwUE9FQnQ5SklDWUoxZmtjUUUtODdqYmJ1QkNzZlZ6ZUZBRGlVY3JTbHRPTTk2SUQxc21iUmlQS1NaRlp2c0xZbWFBaGFNUFFDUl9QWG9yZVNBeW9OUUZSZko4OEI3MmVQRjM4c1p2NDlrUGlYZw) after fresh Middle East escalations, highlighting investor anxiety over energy prices and supply chain disruptions as the Iran war intensifies.

AI.en:

足球.en:
- Iran's World Cup surprise: Star striker Sardar Azmoun omitted from 26-man squad due to lack of match fitness from regional war, with 17 home-based players selected ([Iran star Azmoun shock omission](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48939448/iran-star-sardar-azmoun-shock-omission-world-cup-squad)).
- France's defensive worry: William Saliba is 'very doubtful' for the World Cup after a back injury, sources say, posing a problem for Les Bleus ([Saliba doubtful](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48938049/france-william-saliba-doubtful-world-cup-sources)).
- Bruno Fernandes reflects on his Manchester United tenure, admitting he expected more trophies but remains optimistic under Michael Carrick ([Fernandes: 'I wanted to have won more'](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48937702/bruno-fernandes-wanted-won-more-man-united)).
- Norway beats Sweden 3-1 in a pre-World Cup friendly with Haaland watching from the stands and Isak scoring for Sweden ([Haaland sits, Isak scores](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48940831/haaland-sits-isak-scores-norway-beats-sweden)).
- Southampton owner backs head coach Eckert despite spying scandal, confirming he will not be sacked ([Southampton owner will not sack Eckert](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cq6pn58pmn4o)).

篮球.zh:
- 名人堂教练里克·阿德尔曼去世，享年79岁，执教生涯千胜，[讣闻](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48941923/hall-fame-basketball-coach-rick-adelman-dies-79)
- 库里签约中国品牌李宁，10年代言创历史，结束Under Armour时代，[详情](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48940127/stephen-curry-signs-chinese-sportswear-company-li-ning)
- SGA承诺代表加拿大征战未来三季，穆雷和维金斯落选，[报道](https://www.espn.com/olympics/story/_/id/48941587/shai-gilgeous-alexander-commits-team-canada-jamal-murray-out)
- NBA总决赛前瞻：尼克斯vs马刺，文班亚马与布伦森对决，[分析](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48929293/the-storylines-matchups-define-2026-nba-finals-spurs-knicks-wembanyama-brunson)
篮球.en:
- NBA Finals preview: The Knicks and Spurs collide starting Wednesday; key storylines include how New York can contain Victor Wembanyama and whether Jalen Brunson can overcome size limitations ([Storylines that will define the Finals](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48929293/the-storylines-matchups-define-2026-nba-finals-spurs-knicks-wembanyama-brunson), [Full preview](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48906595/nba-finals-2026-preview-knicks-spurs-wemby-brunson-towns-castle-stats-schedule-predictions)).
- Hall of Fame coach Rick Adelman, who won over 1,000 games, died at 79; his impact on the NBA is remembered ([Adelman dies at 79](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48941923/hall-fame-basketball-coach-rick-adelman-dies-79)).
- Stephen Curry signs a 10-year endorsement deal with Chinese company Li-Ning, ending his sneaker free agency and marking a major move in the sportswear market ([Curry signs with Li-Ning](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48940127/stephen-curry-signs-chinese-sportswear-company-li-ning)).
- Shai Gilgeous-Alexander leads a 23-man Team Canada roster for the next three summers, while Jamal Murray and Andrew Wiggins are omitted ([SGA commits to Canada](https://www.espn.com/olympics/story/_/id/48941587/shai-gilgeous-alexander-commits-team-canada-jamal-murray-out)).
- Mavs plan to move to a new arena outside downtown Dallas by 2031, ending a long tenure at American Airlines Center ([Mavs arena site](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48941658/dallas-mavericks-eyeing-new-arena-site-away-downtown)).

欧美.zh:
- [Lex Luthor’s Iconic Warsuit](https://deadline.com/2026/06/lex-luthor-warsuit-superman-man-of-tomorrow-photo-1236938059/) 《Man of Tomorrow》片场照曝光经典紫色战衣，显示詹姆斯·古恩深谙粉丝情怀，超人电影备受期待。
- [Trump’s Social Media Meltdowns](https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/politics-news/trump-social-media-meltdowns-getting-worse-1235570924/) 特朗普因经济危机和伊朗战争退守Truth Social，情绪失控引发媒体关注，折射政治娱乐化现象。
- [Netflix’s New Releases June 2026](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/netflix-june-2026-new-releases-movies-tv-1236610298/) 网飞公布六月片单，涵盖多部原创电影和剧集，订阅用户可提前规划追剧日程。
- [Euphoria Star Alexa Demie](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/euphoria-alexa-demie-maddy-connection-1235571039/) 亚历克莎·德米谈与角色Maddy的深层羁绊，拍摄结束后因抽离角色而痛哭，演技深度获赞。
- [Singer duets with pre-transition self](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cddpj50709mo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 音乐人Dylan Holloway用AI技术实现与过去自己的二重唱，探讨身份认同变化，视频引爆社交网络。
欧美.en:
- DC's 'Man of Tomorrow' teases Lex Luthor's warsuit ([link](https://deadline.com/2026/06/lex-luthor-warsuit-superman-man-of-tomorrow-photo-1236938059/)) – a nod to fan service and building anticipation for the Superman reboot.
- Jon Stewart returns to The Daily Show, mocking Trump's Freedom 250 concert after mass act cancellations ([link](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/jon-stewart-donald-trump-freedom-250-concert-the-daily-show-1236764663/)) – blending satire with real political events.
- Netflix unveils its June 2026 lineup ([link](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/netflix-june-2026-new-releases-movies-tv-1236610298/)) – a key indicator of streaming trends and audience preferences.
- Alexa Demie opens up about her deep connection to 'Euphoria' character Maddy ([link](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/euphoria-alexa-demie-maddy-connection-1235571039/)) – highlighting the emotional toll of iconic roles.

日韩.zh:

- [杨世宗新剧《Spooky in Love》公开首张剧照](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845187wpp/yang-se-jong-is-an-ace-prosecutor-who-gains-an-unexpected-ability-in-new-drama-spooky-in-love) tvN将翻拍2011年电影《Spellbound》，检察官+见鬼能力的设定，浪漫惊悚混搭引期待。
- [《Doctor on the Edge》首播收视强劲](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845159wpp/doctor-on-the-edge-premieres-with-strong-ratings-the-legend-of-kitchen-soldier-rises-to-no-1) 李宰旭、申艺恩主演的浪漫喜剧拿下同时段高收视，小岛医生与护士的爱情故事开局成功。

- 'Doctor on the Edge' premieres with strong ratings, dominating Monday-Tuesday drama race ([link](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845159wpp/doctor-on-the-edge-premieres-with-strong-ratings-the-legend-of-kitchen-soldier-rises-to-no-1)) – proof of continued K-drama popularity.
- BTS and Oreo launch first global snack collaboration with purple cookies and hotteok-inspired flavor ([link](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxPazdla0RfMUw0aWtndndJa0tzVnVHNjVPNTczVTRoT01GV3VEYVA0eVhrZ1FvUG1RSUZCRTlrTGZJUlBkTTRTemgxRE5XRFZiLS02dzNwQ1hOTkVhOEZ1Y0xuMDkzRXBRNGhWdldUUGFwYkdGa3R1RHZacTdUS2tidDJvUU1LUUR0c0xVVE9ZSllJLWZaRERVYzFkZGZUalpKbGpnZXN1S09CN20tMmJ1UkpoWlhqdjF2UTRvRllOWEJNcVhHZi1oN3ZhYUE)) – a major K-pop brand expansion.
- Multiple new K-dramas confirmed, including Seo In Guk and Krystal in 'The Office Worker Who Sees Destiny' ([link](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845158wpp/seo-in-guk-and-krystal-confirmed-for-new-fantasy-office-drama)) – indicating a busy drama pipeline.
